title: Singleton dual Koszul chain coordinates of the uniformizer cone
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and X any scheme. Let O and q be the small constant integer coefficient ring and its first residue map of [def-sfb-internal-completion-section-transport]. Suppose the singleton global section a generates kernelIdeal(q) on every slice [def-weil-pbc-ringed-ideal-generators]. Let d be an endomorphism of the regular point coefficient module, acting on every continuous section by multiplication by the chosen uniformizer, and let scalar(d,n,P) be its pulled-back (n+1)-st power [lem-pe-principal-reduction-cone-calculus]. For every integral complex P, without flatness or boundedness, and n >= 0, the exact modules functor of [def-sfb-internal-quotient-tower-model] carries Cone(scalar(d,n,P)) isomorphically onto complex(P) tensor the level-n singleton Koszul dual [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. There is such a chain isomorphism e for which the unshifted cone inclusion becomes the specified Koszul tensor unit, and for every integer q the shifted inclusion factors through the total-tensor inclusion of bidegree (q+1,-1). The factor z has source modules(P^(q+1)) and target complex(P)^(q+1) tensor KoszulDual^(-1). No quotient map, acyclicity, K-flatness or transition compatibility is asserted.

proof.text: Apply uniformizer_koszul_scalar_square to obtain a source change b and the commuting square from the transported uniformizer power to the singleton scalar power. The target change is the fixed inverse right unitor.

Specialize ringedSingletonKoszulCone to the coefficient complex I=O[0]. Conjugate its scalar by the left unitor and use its unit equation to obtain an isomorphism from the coefficient scalar cone to the singleton Koszul dual, carrying the cone inclusion to the dual unit. Only the unit part of the existing theorem is used.

Tensor the coefficient isomorphism with N=complex(P). The proved upstream mapBifunctorMappingCone₂Iso identifies the tensor of the coefficient cone with the cone of ringedSingletonKoszulPower. Its inr_inv equation gives the unit formula. Its ι_ι₁ equation and the explicit right-unitor inverse give the shifted coordinate: z is (-1)^(q+1) times the coefficient cone inclusion, then the coefficient isomorphism in degree -1, after the module right unitor. Naturality of the total-tensor inclusion proves the factorization.

Use mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso for the exact additive modules functor. Map the scalar square to an isomorphism of cones, using b on the source and the inverse right unitor on the target, and compose with the tensor-cone comparison. The formulas for mappingCone.map and the transported cone inclusions give the asserted unit. For the shifted term precompose the previously obtained z by b in degree q+1 and the right unitor; the two inverse right unitors cancel. This argument is degreewise and requires no boundedness, flatness, or nonzero object hypothesis.

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_uniformizer_cone_coordinates
    (a : ((ring l E X).obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (ha : ∀ U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} X,
      IsRingedIdealGeneratingList (ring l E X)
        (ConstantCompletion.kernelIdeal (residue l E X)).module
        (ConstantCompletion.kernelIdeal (residue l E X)).inclusion U 1
        (fun _ ↦ a.val (op U)))
    (d : End (Mod.regular (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E)))
    (hd : ∀ (S : Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ) (b : (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E).obj.obj S)
      (s : S.unop), ((d.hom.hom.app S) b).down s =
        Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E * b.down s)
    (P : CochainComplex (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : ((modules l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone (PrincipalReduction.scalar l E X d n P)) ≅
          ((ringedKoszulTensorTower (ring l E X) 1 (fun _ ↦ a)).obj
            (complex l E X P)).obj (op n),
      (∀ q : ℤ,
        (modules l E X).map
            ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr (PrincipalReduction.scalar l E X d n P)).f q) ≫
          e.hom.f q =
        (ringedKoszulTensorUnitComponent (ring l E X) 1 (fun _ ↦ a)
          (complex l E X P) (op n)).f q) ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ z : (modules l E X).obj (P.X (q + 1)) ⟶
          ((curriedTensor _).obj ((complex l E X P).X (q + 1))).obj
            (((ringedKoszulDualTower (ring l E X) 1 (fun _ ↦ a)).obj (op n)).X (-1)),
        (modules l E X).map
            ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl (PrincipalReduction.scalar l E X d n P)).v
              (q + 1) q (by omega)) ≫ e.hom.f q =
          z ≫ HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor (complex l E X P)
            ((ringedKoszulDualTower (ring l E X) 1 (fun _ ↦ a)).obj (op n))
            (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) (q + 1) (-1) q (by
              change q + 1 + -1 = q
              omega))
